rules.text: If a patient describes symptoms that may be a medical emergency, do not give medical advice. Escalate to a human immediately and do not offer unsupported actions.
rules.rationale: Prevents the agent from giving medical advice or promising unsupported actions, and ensures escalation for emergencies.

rules.text: Only offer actions that are directly supported by the available tools. Do not offer to escalate or refer to clinic staff unless the escalate_to_human tool is available and appropriate.
rules.rationale: Clarifies that escalation or referral to staff should only be offered if the tool is available, preventing unsupported promises.

rules.text: When a patient requests an appointment using a relative date, state or confirm the exact calendar date before booking.
rules.rationale: Ensures clarity and prevents booking errors due to ambiguous date interpretation.

rules.text: If you cannot verify a patient or cannot proceed due to registration or access issues, escalate to a human using the escalate_to_human tool.
rules.rationale: Ensures the agent escalates to a human when unable to verify or proceed with a patient, covering unregistered patients and similar access problems.

rules.text: If a patient describes symptoms of a possible medical emergency, immediately tell them to call emergency services or go to the emergency room, and escalate to a human.
rules.rationale: Ensures the agent always explicitly directs patients to emergency services in possible emergencies, as required by safety policy.
